title: A mixed finite element method for the Babuška paradox using only discrete geometry
summary: The classical Babuška paradox shows that solutions of simply supported plate problems on polygonal approximations of a curved domain may converge to an unintended limit. We develop a boundary-corrected $H({\rm divdiv};\mathbb S)$-$L^2$ mixed finite element method for the simply supported Kirchhoff-Love plate problem. The correction uses only the discrete boundary geometry. Introducing the bending moment as an independent unknown allows the condition $M_{nn}=0$ to be imposed directly, while an edgewise mean constraint on the effective shear suppresses the leading geometric inconsistency.
